name: Tsukamoto Ryouta
source:
Born in March.
[url=/c43344]Soushi's[/url] younger twin brother.
A calm guy who does things at his own pace, but he has the power to completely shut down Soushi and [url=/c43346]Kiyoharu[/url] when they get too excited.
